visual_review.scope: Six manually inspected images: extended 43-field fixture and installed release memory tab on Ubuntu 24.04, Rocky Linux 8 and Rocky Linux 10
observations: All 43 fixture rows are visible through tCPDED; complete 64-bit register strings and the bottom explanation fit on all three inspected targets
Occupied Rank0/Rank1 RTL values 40/44 show QCLK; Rank2/Rank3 show Rank absent with no unit
tCSL/tCSH values 9/11 show MC DCLK; other applicable timing fields show tCK
DDR5 tXPDLL and tCPDED are marked Not used; context states DDR5, rank mask 0x03 and snapshot v2
EL10 larger row geometry is accommodated without clipping the final row or wrapped footer
Installed release tabs show the read/open controls and empty initial table; Copy/Save remain disabled until a snapshot is loaded

limits: Live reads require CPUID Intel family 6 model B7 without a hypervisor, PCI 8086:A700 class 060000 and an already enabled MCHBAR
DDR4 supports channel 0 only; DDR5 supports channel 0 or 1; these indices do not identify physical motherboard DIMM slots
Two matching snapshots detect changes but are not atomic hardware measurements; all fixture values are synthetic
Gear division overrides retain encoded values for tCK fields; RTL remains QCLK and CSL/CSH remain MC_DCLK; no writes are implemented by this feature
Other AMD, Intel and board-specific protocols, target hardware and Secure Boot validation remain pending
Portable core validation on Windows/macOS is not a full hardware port
